title: ピーターラビット (Peter Rabbit / The Tale of Peter Rabbit)
description: Peter Rabbit squeezes into Mr. McGregor's garden despite his mother's warnings. He eats vegetables, gets chased, barely escapes, and arrives home exhausted while his siblings eat blackberries. Classic children's story about disobedience and consequences. Originally by Beatrix Potter (1902), adapted into Japanese for Tadoku Level 1.
author: Beatrix Potter (adapted by NPO多言語多読)
